query: What exact pre-registration items (power/sample-size analysis, statistical tests, CI/reporting standards, number of seeds) must we commit to before running causal grounding pilots?

response.query: What exact pre-registration items (power/sample-size analysis, statistical tests, CI/reporting standards, number of seeds) must we commit to before running causal grounding pilots?
response.answer: Before running causal grounding pilots, commit to power/sample-size analysis, statistical tests, CI/reporting standards, and number of seeds. These pre-registration items ensure methodological rigor and transparency.
